What is omacalc?

Omacalc is a minimal calculator app built with Qt Quick and C++, made for the Omarchy desktop. It handles standard arithmetic with proper operator precedence, decimals, percentages, and sign toggling, showing your typed expression above the result so you can double-check your input. It automatically follows your system's Omarchy theme and light/dark mode, and supports full keyboard entry.

Install omacalc on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add omacalc
